briefing: - 今日清单未见KEV或勒索标记，暂无在野利用确证，勿因无标记放松。
- 优先处置Pillow命令注入RCE：9.8且已有POC，并涉堆溢出。
- 边界VPN 9.5栈溢出、认证绕过/缺失认证9.8扎堆，应优先排查。
- Adobe代码注入RCE 9.6及邮件弱加密9.1同批出现，需厂商补丁跟进。
- 批量公告以开发库依赖为主，Pillow单产品多漏洞，建议统一升级至13.0.0。

items.title: Pillow EPS参数注入致RCE
items.summary_zh: 应用处理EPS并可控文件名时，攻击者可注入Ghostscript参数执行命令
items.action_zh: 升级至13.0.0并禁用EPS或限制Ghostscript调用
items.repro_note: 需处理EPS输入且可控制文件名，向Ghostscript参数注入
items.impact_scope: 开发库/依赖，影响图像处理服务
items.description: From 2.6.0 until 13.0.0, Pillow is vulnerable to argument injection when invoking Ghostscript for EPS input. An attacker who controls the filename can inject Ghostscript arguments.

items.title: Pillow JPEG缩略图堆溢出
items.summary_zh: 应用用draft()/thumbnail()缩放恶意JPEG时，可堆溢出并可能RCE
items.action_zh: 升级至13.0.0并校验不可信图像输入
items.repro_note: 需应用调用draft/thumbnail处理攻击者JPEG，触发堆越界写
items.impact_scope: 开发库/依赖，图像处理链路
items.description: An attacker can supply such a JPEG to an application that uses draft() or thumbnail() to request downscaling. This can corrupt heap memory, crash the process, or potentially allow code execution.

items.title: Pillow FlashPix堆溢出可RCE
items.summary_zh: 安装olefile且处理不可信FlashPix时，恶意OLE2文件可堆溢出并可能RCE
items.action_zh: 升级至13.0.0，禁用olefile或隔离不可信文件
items.repro_note: 需安装olefile并打开/缩略图不可信OLE2 FlashPix文件
items.impact_scope: 开发库/依赖，文档图像处理
items.description: An attacker can supply a crafted OLE2 FlashPix file to an application with the optional olefile dependency installed that opens or thumbnails untrusted input. This can corrupt heap memory and may allow arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Java反序列化默认校验绕过RCE
items.title_zh: Java反序列化默认校验绕过RCE
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者提交特制类型ID，绕过默认校验触发反序列化并执行代码
items.action_zh: 升级依赖，禁用Id.CLASS并启用反序列化白名单
items.repro_note: 需应用使用Id.CLASS，提交包装类类型ID绕过默认校验
items.impact_scope: 开发库/依赖，影响Java服务
items.description: The default-validator case requires no application-authored validator: with @JsonTypeInfo(use = Id.CLASS), a direct gadget type ID is rejected as "Not a subtype", while a type ID naming a generic wrapper around the same gadget is accepted and deserialized, including attacker-supplied bean properties.

items.title: Asterisk MWI NOTIFY栈溢出
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者可发特制MWI NOTIFY，Message-Account超长致栈溢出并瘫痪SIP
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.repro_note: 未授权发MWI NOTIFY，超长Message-Account触发栈溢出
items.impact_scope: SIP/PBX边界，常暴露公网
items.description: Asterisk is an open source private branch exchange and telephony toolkit. Prior to Asterisk 20.20.1, 21.12.3, 22.10.1, 23.4.1 and Certified Asterisk 20.7-cert11, 22.8-cert3, an unbounded `sscanf` in `res_pjsip_pubsub` when parsing the `MWI NOTIFY` `Message-Account` field may allow an unauthenticated attacker to send a carefully crafted packet that causes a stack buffer overflow and corrupts the underlying transport, permanently disabling all SIP functionality.

items.title: Asterisk ARI只读越权写文件
items.summary_zh: 只读ARI用户经setChannelVar执行写拨号函数，可写文件并扩大控制
items.repro_note: 需只读ARI权限，调用setChannelVar执行FILE()等写函数
items.impact_scope: PBX管理接口，低权限横向
items.description: Prior to Asterisk 20.20.1, 21.12.3, 22.10.1, 23.4.1 and Certified Asterisk 20.7-cert11, 22.8-cert3, an authenticated Asterisk REST Interface (ARI) attacker with read-only privileges may use `setChannelVar` to execute write dialplan functions, including `FILE()` writes, even when `live_dangerously` in `asterisk.conf` is set to no. The Asterisk HTTP web server must be enabled and reachable, and the attacker must already have valid `read-only ARI credentials`.

items.title: Asterisk特制报文越界写致崩溃
items.title_zh: Asterisk特制报文越界写致崩溃
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可发送特制报文触发越界写，导致Asterisk进程崩溃
items.repro_note: 向Asterisk相关服务发送特制报文，触发越界写崩溃
items.impact_scope: VoIP/PBX服务，可能中断通信
items.description: Asterisk is an open source private branch exchange and telephony toolkit. A remote attacker may send a carefully crafted packet that causes the Asterisk process to crash.

items.title: Asterisk OOH323号码解析缺陷
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者可构造Q.931报文触发OOH323号码解析缺陷，影响通道处理
items.repro_note: 向OOH323服务发送特制Q.931 party-number报文触发解析
items.impact_scope: VoIP/PBX，OOH323通道
items.description: Asterisk is an open source private branch exchange and telephony toolkit. From 21.0.0-pre1 until Asterisk 21.12.3, 22.10.1, 23.4.1 and Certified Asterisk 22.8-cert3, the `chan_ooh323` `Q.931 party-number parser` lacks the `CVE-2022-37325` fix because that fix was never forward-ported from Asterisk 20 to later versions.

items.title: Asterisk XMPP前缀处理栈溢出
items.summary_zh: 已认证攻击者构造特制XMPP包，触发res_xmpp栈溢出，可崩溃或执行
items.repro_note: 需认证访问XMPP，构造超长namespace前缀包触发
items.impact_scope: VoIP/PBX的XMPP通道
items.description: Prior to Asterisk 20.20.1, 21.12.3, 22.10.1, 23.4.1 and Certified Asterisk 20.7-cert11, 22.8-cert3, an authenticated attacker may cause a stack buffer overflow in `res_xmpp` `XMPP namespace prefix` handling using carefully crafted packets. The `res_xmpp` module must be loaded, an XMPP connection must be configured in `xmpp.conf`, and the attacker must have an XMPP account on the same or a federated server.

items.title: Asterisk CEL后端SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 可控CEL eventtype进入PostgreSQL/MSSQL后端，可执行任意SQL，影响数据库
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；限制CELGenUserEvent权限并参数化
items.repro_note: 启用CEL SQL后端，经CELGenUserEvent写入恶意值
items.impact_scope: PBX数据库后端，数据泄露
items.description: Asterisk is an open source private branch exchange and telephony toolkit. Prior to Asterisk 20.20.1, 21.12.3, 22.10.1, 23.4.1 and Certified Asterisk 20.7-cert11, 22.8-cert3, the `PostgreSQL` and `TDS/MSSQL` Channel Event Log backends `cel_pgsql` and `cel_tds` may permit arbitrary SQL execution when untrusted data is set in the CEL `eventtype` column by the `CELGenUserEvent` dialplan application.

items.title: Asterisk特制文件堆溢出
items.summary_zh: 攻击者需高权限投放或诱管理员提供特制文件，可堆溢出并可能执行代码
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·需低权限)
items.repro_note: 需先创建并使Asterisk可访问特制文件，触发堆越界写
items.impact_scope: VoIP/PBX本地文件处理
items.description: Asterisk is an open source private branch exchange and telephony toolkit. The attacker must create the file and make it available to Asterisk either through sufficiently elevated privileges or by convincing an Asterisk administrator to make it available.

items.title: Asterisk AMI空指针崩溃
items.summary_zh: 连接AMI HTTP并采用Digest认证时，未授权攻击者可触发空指针致崩溃
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；AMI HTTP避免暴露并限制127.0.0.1
items.repro_note: 需可访问AMI HTTP，Digest认证下构造请求触发空指针
items.impact_scope: PBX管理接口，默认仅本机
items.description: Prior to Asterisk 20.20.1, 21.12.3, 22.10.1, 23.4.1 and Certified Asterisk 20.7-cert11, 22.8-cert3, a NULL pointer dereference in the `Asterisk Manager Interface (AMI)` may allow an unauthenticated attacker to crash Asterisk when `Digest Authentication` is used via `HTTP`. The attacker must be able to connect to the `HTTP` server, which binds only to `127.0.0.1` by default even when enabled.

items.title: Eaton easyE4静态Nonce重放
items.summary_zh: 可捕获认证流量者重放有效认证交换，未授权访问easyE4设备
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级固件，启用防重放并隔离设备网络
items.repro_note: 需抓取设备认证流量，重放含静态nonce的有效认证交换
items.impact_scope: 工业控制/PLC设备，边界暴露
items.description: Eaton easyE4 uses a static nonce during authentication, which could allow an unauthenticated attacker with access to captured authentication traffic to replay a valid authentication exchange and gain unauthorized access to the device.

items.title: Asterisk ARI只读越权致RCE
items.summary_zh: 只读ARI用户经REST-over-WebSocket越权写操作，加载任意模块并条件RCE
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·需低权限)
items.repro_note: 需只读ARI权限，经WebSocket绕过授权执行写操作
items.impact_scope: PBX管理接口，可致RCE
items.description: Prior to Asterisk 20.20.1, 21.12.3, 22.10.1, 23.4.1 and Certified Asterisk 22.8-cert3, an authenticated attacker with read-only permissions for the `Asterisk REST Interface (ARI)` may, under certain conditions, execute write operations through `REST-over-WebSocket`. The authorization bypass permits `arbitrary module path` loading and conditional remote code execution.

items.title: Fireware WireGuard栈溢出
items.summary_zh: 具TLS解密中间人能力者可篡改Cloud配置，致Firebox拒绝服务或RCE
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级Fireware OS并加固Firebox与Cloud链路
items.repro_note: 需TLS解密中间人访问，篡改FireCloud Gateway配置载荷
items.impact_scope: 边界防火墙/VPN设备
items.description: A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in Fireware OS's WireGuard configuration processing allows a remote attacker that has man-in-the-middle TLS-decrypted access between the Firebox and WatchGuard Cloud to create a Denial of Service condition and potentially execute arbitrary code by tampering with a FireCloud Gateway configuration payload.

items.title: 邮件系统TLS弱加密可致中间人
items.title_zh: 邮件系统TLS弱加密可致中间人
items.summary_zh: 未认证网络攻击者可伪造服务器证书，拦截或篡改外发TLS流量
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.action_zh: 升级产品，禁用弱加密并启用严格证书校验
items.repro_note: 需网络中间人位置，利用弱加密/证书校验缺陷劫持TLS
items.impact_scope: 邮件系统外发TLS链路
items.description: Private keys for eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificates have been compromised https://emudhra.we-have-a-problem.com/ , which impacts certificate trust for outbound network request features of HCL Domino Server. An unauthenticated network attacker could spoof server certificates to execute a man in the middle (MITM) attack, enabling them to intercept and/or modify the content of outbound TLS connections.

items.title: IPMI 未授权 缺失认证
items.description: The BMC does not correctly enforce integrity and encryption requirements for IPMI commands. An attacker may be able to craft packets that execute arbitrary commands on an active session.

items.title: REDAXO 未授权 认证绕过
items.description: REDAXO core from 5.3.0 before 5.21.4 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the structure/history plugin that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge temporary login tokens. Attackers can force the session-tied secret into a predictable state and forge tokens for accounts like admin, gaining backend access and code execution outside live mode.

items.title: JWT_SECRET 未授权 CWE-321
items.description: nest-admin before 1.0.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge administrator tokens by using a hardcoded JWT_SECRET committed in .env.production. Attackers can sign tokens with the known secret that JwtStrategy and RbacGuard trust, impersonating any user ID or claiming the admin role for full administrative access.

items.title: Subsequent 未授权 整数溢出
items.description: In EPICS Base release 7.0.10 and prior, an integer overflow in network request processing can cause memory to be allocated with an incorrect size. Subsequent handling of attacker supplied data may result in memory corruption, denial of service, or potential remote code execution.

items.title: Cross-Site Request Forgery 未授权 CSRF
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.description: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in Tribulant Software Newsletters newsletters-lite allows Cross Site Request Forgery.This issue affects Newsletters: from n/a through 4.18.2.

items.title: Adobe Connect 未授权 代码注入(RCE)
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.affected: Adobe(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.description: Adobe Connect is affected by an Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection') vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code. Exploitation of this issue requires user interaction in that a victim must visit a maliciously crafted URL or interact with a compromised web page. Scope is changed.

items.title: FireCluster Sync 命令注入
items.description: A missing authentication vulnerability in the FireCluster Sync processing allows an attacker positioned on the cluster interconnect, such as a compromised cluster peer or an on-path network attacker, to invoke privileged firewall management actions as root by sending a specially crafted request.

items.title: Adobe 未授权 XSS
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.affected: Adobe(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.description: Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC) is affected by a reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to inject malicious scripts into a web page, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session. Exploitation of this issue requires user interaction in that a victim must visit a maliciously crafted URL or interact with a compromised web page. Scope is changed.

items.title: monai 输入校验缺失
items.description: ### Summary An unauthenticated remote attacker can crash a running MONAILabel server or silently corrupt its medical AI inference results by uploading a single crafted DICOM file (~132 KB) via the REST API. The vulnerability stems from pydicom's lack of validation for Decimal String (DS) and Integer String (IS) DICOM Value Representations, which allows NaN and infinity values to pass through MONAI's PydicomReader and propagate through the entire spatial transform and ML inference pipeline.

items.title: Fireware OS 未授权 堆溢出
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Fireware OS authentication service allows an attacker who controls or intercepts traffic to the configured Active Directory server to create a denial of service condition and potentially execute arbitrary code by returning a specially crafted response.

items.title: Fireware OS 未授权 堆溢出
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the Fireware OS authentication service allows an attacker who controls or intercepts traffic to the configured Active Directory server to create a denial of service condition and potentially execute arbitrary code by returning a specially crafted response.

items.title: Fireware OS 未授权 缓冲区溢出
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in Fireware OS's SIP proxy allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code by sending a specially crafted request through a policy that uses the SIP proxy.

items.title: Fireware OS FireCluster 未授权 命令注入
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: A missing authentication vulnerability in the Fireware OS FireCluster synchronization daemon allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to invoke privileged system-level administrative actions by sending a specially crafted request to the FireCluster management IP when the clustering feature is enabled.

items.title: WebSocket 未授权 整数溢出
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: An integer overflow vulnerability in the WebSocket connection handling used by WatchGuard Fireware OS's Access Portal allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to write beyond the bounds of a heap buffer by sending a specially crafted request while the Access Portal feature is enabled.

items.title: better-auth 认证绕过
items.description: ## Impact An unauthenticated attacker who knows a user's email address can get a normal session for that user, with all of that account's permissions. The false verified-email flag can also bypass Better Auth's default unproven-account protections when the mailbox owner later signs in, leaving the attacker's session in that account.

items.title: authlib 签名校验错误
items.description: Authlib (prior to 1.9.0) contains a signature verification bypass vulnerability.

items.title: Fastify 未授权 CWE-436
items.description: @fastify/express is a Fastify plugin that runs Express middleware inside Fastify. An unauthenticated attacker needs only the non-default ignoreDuplicateSlashes option to be enabled.

items.title: OAuth 未授权 证书校验缺陷
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)
items.description: In Eclipse ioFog Operator versions 3.8.0 before 3.9.2, TLS certificate verification is disabled when the operator contacts the Controller API and when it logs in to an external OIDC issuer. An on-path attacker can present any certificate, capture the OAuth client secret (external mode) or the Controller bootstrap admin password (embedded mode with Controller HTTPS enabled), and supply the access token the operator stores for later Controller API calls.

items.title: Adobe Campaign Classic SQL注入
items.affected: Adobe(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.description: Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC) is affected by an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability that could result in a Security feature bypass. A low-privileged attacker could leverage this vulnerability to bypass security measures and gain unauthorized read and limited write access. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed.

items.title: CDP Coordinator Service 未授权 CWE-636
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)

items.title: Sunhillo SureLine 未授权 CWE-565

items.title: HiRDB OS命令注入可致RCE

items.action_zh: 升级官方修复版本，限制HiRDB服务访问
items.repro_note: 定位可注入参数，构造命令分隔符向HiRDB服务注入
items.impact_scope: 数据库服务，后端核心资产
items.description: OS Command Injection Vulnerability in HiRDB. This issue affects HiRDB Server Version 10: from 10-00 before 10-12-01; HiRDB Server Version 9: from 09-00 through 09-66-22; HiRDB Server with Additional Function Version 9: from 09-00 through 09-66/V; HiRDB Server Version 9(32): from 09-02 through 09-66-22; HiRDB Server with Additional Function Version 9(32): from 09-00 through 09-66-/V.

items.title: Adobe Campaign代码注入RCE

items.title: Agno代码注入可致RCE
items.summary_zh: 可影响FunctionCall输入的攻击者借助field_type注入，经eval执行任意Python代码。
items.action_zh: 升级至2.3.24，避免eval处理外部输入
items.repro_note: 入口为FunctionCall.field_type，需可控输入进入eval
items.impact_scope: AI Agent框架，开发与运行环境
items.description: ### Impact Agno versions prior to 2.3.24 contain an arbitrary code execution vulnerability in the model execution component. The `field_type` parameter on a `FunctionCall` input field was passed to Python's built-in `eval()`, allowing an attacker who could influence that value to execute arbitrary Python code in the Agno process.

items.title: JP1作业管理认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可绕过Manager认证访问作业管理功能，可能接管调度任务或窃取敏感信息。
items.action_zh: 升级至13-50-31或更高版本，限制管理端口
items.repro_note: 访问Manager管理接口，构造伪造认证请求绕过
items.impact_scope: 企业作业调度平台，内网核心
items.description: Authentication Bypass Vulnerability in JP1/Automatic Job Management System 3. This issue affects JP1/Automatic Job Management System 3 - Manager: from 10-00 before 13-50-31.

items.title: HiRDB认证欺骗可绕过认证
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可通过欺骗方式绕过HiRDB认证，进而未授权访问数据库并窃取或篡改数据。
items.action_zh: 升级至10-12-01等修复版本，限制数据库端口
items.repro_note: 访问HiRDB认证接口，伪造凭据绕过认证
items.impact_scope: 企业数据库，内网数据核心
items.description: Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability in HiRDB. This issue affects HiRDB Server Version 10: from 10-00 before 10-12-01; HiRDB Server Version 9: from 09-00 through 09-66-22; HiRDB Server with Additional Function Version 9: from 09-00 through 09-66/V; HiRDB Server Version 9(32): from 09-02 through 09-66-22; HiRDB Server with Additional Function Version 9(32): from 09-00 through 09-66-/V.

items.title: PHP 代码注入(RCE)
items.description: Prior to the advisory-reported fixed version 4.5.0, an administrator can inject malicious PHP through LDAP connector configuration parameters such as `ldap_filter`, poisoning `/personnalisation/config_ldap.inc.php` and permitting remote code execution. The administrator must first successfully connect to an LDAP server, which can be attacker-controlled, and then submit malicious input on the subsequent connector settings page.

items.title: Veeam Backup SQL注入
items.difficulty: 中(远程·利用条件苛刻·需低权限)
items.description: A vulnerability allowing an authenticated organization-transfer peer to inject SQL into the configuration database of the source Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 server, leading to cross-tenant read and write of configuration data and remote code execution as the PostgreSQL service account.
